title: Hear the 12-bar form
prompt: Welcome to the blues. Twelve bars, three chords, one shape that thousands of songs share.

generatorParams.promptText: Count the bars out loud: four bars of C, two of F, two of C, one G, one F, then home — C and a G turnaround.

title: The form by the numbers
prompt: Know the map before you drive it: which chord owns which bar.

title: The whole form in blocked chords
prompt: One chord per bar, both hands. Say the chord names as you land them.
successRule: Play the form through — every chord right; a slip means a replay.

title: The wants-to-go-home chord
prompt: A preview of next tier’s star: G7 — the chord that leans toward home.

generatorParams.promptText: Hear the lean, then the landing. G7 is restless; C is home. Bar 9 of the blues rides exactly this pull.

title: Home or leaning?
prompt: The change is something you hear before you name it. Settled major, or that leaning, buzzier seventh?

title: Walk the form in the bass
prompt: Left hand only: a root on every beat, changing exactly on the barline.
successRule: Every root right, every change on time; a slip means a replay.

title: Eyes on the symbols
prompt: No falling notes this time — read the chord symbols and count the bars. This is how blues players actually think.
successRule: Earn at least one star from the symbols alone — every note right; a slip means a replay.

title: A full chorus
prompt: The whole 12 bars, both hands, at your tempo.
successRule: Earn at least one star — every note right; a slip means a replay.

title: Tier 6 check: the form, inside and out
prompt: The Tier 6 knowledge check — the form by number, by bar, and by ear.

title: Performance: 12-Bar Blues in C
prompt: The Tier 6 boss: a full chorus at 84 BPM, unassisted, every change on its bar.
successRule: Earn the mastery star: three stars at tempo, no assists — every note right; a slip means a replay.

title: Boss Challenge: Pinetop’s changes
prompt: The same three chords you just mastered, driving a boogie-woogie eighteen tiers up. Just explore.
successRule: No stars, no failure — feel how the changes you know power the big piece.
